subject: Broken Signals in Deep Sleep: How 'Lonely' Brain Waves Reveal Hidden Memory Loss
script: From Agewell Brief: Broken Signals in Deep Sleep: How 'Lonely' Brain Waves Reveal Hidden Memory Loss. Researchers at UC Berkeley reveal that tau protein accumulation disrupts the sweeping bioelectric waves of deep sleep, fracturing overnight memory consolidation long before cognitive symptoms surface. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
